title: This is my family
subtitle: Omar shows Elif some family photos
canDo: I can name the people in my family.
I can use my, your, his, her, our and their.
I can understand a short text about a family.
teacherNotes: Warm-up: İsterseniz kendi aile fotoğrafınızdan birini paylaşın ve "This is my mother…" diye tanıtın.
his / her Türk öğrenciler için zor, çünkü Türkçede tek "onun" var. Kural: sahibi erkekse his, kadınsa her (Omar → his sister, Lina → her brother).
Arap öğrencilere: his / her seçimi Arapçadaki ـه / ـها ile aynı mantık (sahibine göre). Fark şu: İngilizcede kelime ismin önüne gelir.
Rol yapma: Öğrenciler telefonlarındaki bir aile fotoğrafını (ya da hayalî bir aileyi) anlatsın.

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: Family photos
sections.scene: Sam's café. Omar shows Elif some photos on his phone.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Is that a family photo, Omar?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Yes, it is. Look — this is my father, and this is my mother.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Oh, nice! Where are your parents?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: They're in Amman. My father is a teacher, and my mother is a doctor.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: That's my sister, Lina. She's twenty-two. She's a student at a university in Amman.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: And the man with the little boy?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: That's my brother, Kareem, and his son, Adam. Adam is four.

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: He's so cute! Is his wife in the photo?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: No, she isn't. Her name is Hala. They're from Amman, but their apartment is in Dubai now.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: That's our grandmother. She's eighty-five, and she's the boss of the family!

sections.title: Family words

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: My family
sections.intro: Elif writes about her family in Izmir.
paragraphs: He's fifty-two, and he's a taxi driver.
He's a student, and his favorite sport is football.

sections.title: Grammar: my, your, his, her…
rules: Put my, your, his … before a noun: **my** brother, **her** name.
**his** = of a man · **her** = of a woman: Omar → **his** sister, Lina → **her** brother.
They don't change for plurals: **my** brother → **my** brothers.
examples: Their house is near the sea.

support.tr: Türkçede iyelik çoğunlukla ekle yapılır: kardeşim, kardeşin. İngilizcede ise ismin önüne ayrı bir kelime gelir: my sister (kız kardeşim), your sister (kız kardeşin). Türkçedeki "onun" için iki kelime vardır: his (erkeğin) ve her (kadının). Sahibi erkekse his, kadınsa her: Omar and his sister = Omar ve (onun) kız kardeşi.
support.ar: في العربية نضيف ضميرًا متّصلًا في آخر الكلمة: أختي، أختك، أخته، أختها. في الإنجليزية نضع كلمة منفصلة قبل الاسم: my sister (أختي)، your sister (أختك)، his sister (أخته)، her sister (أختها)، our sister (أختنا)، their sister (أختهم). ونختار his أو her حسب صاحب الشيء، تمامًا مثل ـه و ـها في العربية.

tr.note: "Onun" için sahibine bak: erkekse his, kadınsa her. Türkçede tek kelime olduğu için çok karışır.

ar.note: لا نضع الضمير في آخر الكلمة، بل نضع my / your / his … قبلها، ولا نستخدم the معها.

sections.title: Practice
sections.instructions: Complete with my, your, his, her, our or their.

support.tr: my, your, his, her, our veya their ile tamamla.
support.ar: أكمل بـ my أو your أو his أو her أو our أو their.

items: Lina is a student. {Her} university is in Amman.
Kareem and Hala are in Dubai. {Their} son is four.
Elif, is this {your} bag? — Yes, it is. Thank you!
Omar is a nurse. {His} hospital is in Boston.

items.audio: This is my sister. Her name is Ana. She's nineteen.
My parents are from Boston, but their house is in Florida now.
My wife is Emma. Our dog is Biscuit.
